title: Verify: HeaderOverlay and App shell unit tests with mocked API
summary: Unit tests for header content, store bindings and App composition
description: Test HeaderOverlay directly and App with the API client mocked.
acceptance_criteria: Header content, sound, settings and error states asserted
technical_constraints: vi.mock('../src/api/client') for getCurrentRound; fixtures in tests/fixtures/api.ts mirror the Round type in src/api/client.ts; vi.mock('motion/react') to plain elements

steps.action: Mock motion/react (motion.header -> header). Render with a Round from tests/fixtures/api.ts (shape of Round in src/api/client.ts) and worldName 'The Boy\'s Room'; assert text StoryForge, world name, round id and status visible
steps.command: npx vitest run tests/header.test.tsx -t 'shows round info'

steps.symbol: it('sound and settings buttons update the store; error shown')
steps.action: Click 'Toggle sound' and assert aria-pressed flips and useUiStore soundEnabled false; click 'Settings' and assert settingsOpen true; render with round undefined and error 'Network down' and assert role alert contains 'Network down'
steps.command: npx vitest run tests/header.test.tsx -t 'sound and settings'

steps.symbol: new it('after Begin the header is present and Suggest opens the sheet via the store')
steps.action: With getCurrentRound mocked to resolve the fixture round, render App, click Begin, assert StoryForge text visible, click 'Suggest What Happens Next' and assert useUiStore.getState().modal === 'contribution'; reset store in afterEach
steps.command: npx vitest run tests/app.test.tsx -t 'header is present'
steps.expected: test passes and existing app tests still pass
